dossiq._comment: A SCHEMA THIS FRAGMENT DEFINES BUT DOES NOT LIST HERE IS IMPORTED AND THEN UNREACHABLE. OpenRegister resolves a schema slug WITHIN the register a caller names (components.registers.*.schemas is the boundary), so an unlisted slug answers `Schema slug "x" is not carried by register "dossiq"` at the first read or write. Measured on a fresh rig: 16 lhsMatrixCell seed rows failed exactly this way.

fieldInspection.title: Field Inspection
fieldInspection.description: A planned or in-progress field inspection synchronized to an inspector's device for offline fieldwork. Extends a Dossiq case with offline lifecycle metadata.

caseRef.title: Case Reference
caseRef.description: Reference to the Dossiq case this inspection belongs to

inspectorRef.title: Inspector Reference
inspectorRef.description: User UID of the inspector assigned to this inspection

checklistTemplateRef.title: Checklist Template Reference
checklistTemplateRef.description: Reference to the inspectionChecklist template the inspector must complete for this inspection. Read off the planned item by the field-inspection leaf (offlineConfig.templateRefField) to load the checklist offline, and copied onto the resulting checklistResult

startedAt.title: Started At
startedAt.description: Actual start date and time (set when work begins on site)

completedAt.title: Completed At
completedAt.description: Date and time the inspection was completed

gpsLocation.title: GPS Location
gpsLocation.description: GPS coordinates captured at inspection start

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Timestamp at which the GPS reading was taken

status.title: Status
status.description: Offline lifecycle status of the inspection

offlineCreatedAt.title: Offline Created At
offlineCreatedAt.description: Timestamp the record was created on the offline device

syncedAt.title: Synced At
syncedAt.description: Timestamp the record was successfully synchronized to the server

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Stable identifier of the device that owns the offline copy

checklistResult.title: Checklist Result
checklistResult.description: Per-item answers captured offline for a single field inspection against a checklist template.

inspectionRef.title: Inspection Reference
inspectionRef.description: Reference to the fieldInspection this result belongs to

checklistTemplateRef.title: Checklist Template Reference
checklistTemplateRef.description: Reference to the inspectionChecklist template used

questionId.title: Question ID
questionId.description: Reference to the checklist template question

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Answer given for this checklist question

evidenceRefs.title: Evidence References
evidenceRefs.description: References to fieldEvidence records for this answer

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional notes for this checklist item

answeredAt.title: Answered At
answeredAt.description: Timestamp at which this question was answered

gpsAtAnswer.title: GPS At Answer
gpsAtAnswer.description: GPS location at the time the question was answered

source.title: Source
source.description: Whether coordinates came from the GPS sensor or fell back to the case address

fieldEvidence.title: Field Evidence
fieldEvidence.description: A piece of evidence (photo, voice memo, document, or sketch) captured offline during a field inspection.

inspectionRef.title: Inspection Reference
inspectionRef.description: Reference to the fieldInspection this evidence belongs to

localBlobRef.title: Local Blob Reference
localBlobRef.description: IndexedDB reference to the local blob prior to upload

cloudUrl.title: Cloud URL
cloudUrl.description: URL of the uploaded file once synced (nullable until upload completes)

gpsLocation.title: GPS Location
gpsLocation.description: GPS coordinates captured at the moment the evidence was recorded

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Timestamp at which the GPS reading was taken

capturedAt.title: Captured At
capturedAt.description: Timestamp at which the evidence was captured

transcriptionStatus.title: Transcription Status
transcriptionStatus.description: Current status of the transcription process

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form classification tags for this evidence item

sensitivityLevel.title: Sensitivity Level
sensitivityLevel.description: AVG/GDPR sensitivity classification of the evidence

syncQueue.title: Sync Queue Operation
syncQueue.description: A single mutation queued offline to be replayed against OpenRegister when the device reconnects.

operationType.title: Operation Type
operationType.description: Type of sync operation, e.g. create, update, delete

targetEntity.title: Target Entity
targetEntity.description: Schema slug the operation targets (e.g. checklistResult, fieldEvidence)

queuedAt.title: Queued At
queuedAt.description: Timestamp the operation was queued (replay ordering key)

lastAttemptAt.title: Last Attempt At
lastAttemptAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent sync attempt

lastError.title: Last Error
lastError.description: Last error message recorded on failure

status.title: Status
status.description: Current status of this sync queue entry

conflictRecord.title: Conflict Record
conflictRecord.description: Records a concurrent-edit, deleted-remote, or permission-lost conflict detected while replaying a queued operation, plus its resolution for AVG audit.

syncQueueRef.title: Sync Queue Reference
syncQueueRef.description: Reference to the syncQueue operation that conflicted

serverVersion.title: Server Version
serverVersion.description: Snapshot of the server-side object at conflict time

clientVersion.title: Client Version
clientVersion.description: Snapshot of the client-side (offline) object at conflict time

conflictType.title: Conflict Type
conflictType.description: Type of conflict detected during synchronization

resolvedBy.title: Resolved By

resolvedAt.title: Resolved At
resolvedAt.description: Timestamp at which the conflict was resolved
